proposal.reason: Main change is to reviewer-routing/review-gate behavior, owned by workflow: .github/scripts/review_automation.py changes classification freshness keys (pr/head/base_ref), excludes title/body from routing fingerprints and snapshot checks, allows patch_omitted fallback, and adds typed GraphQL withdrawal logic for pending review requests; .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py aligns gate staleness checks to PR head/target only; .github/workflows/review-routing.yml skips title/body-only edited events. These are review policy/automation contract updates, not PCCL runtime modules or CI test orchestration.
